description: Load a self-contained demo into your workspace: a memory store, a small catalog, competitor prices below it and an undercut policy in manual mode, so run_commerce_cycle drafts proposals you can approve. Safe to repeat; it reuses what it made. Needs a Last Price credential with commerce configure scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: seed_commerce_sample
